verdict.rationale: Angular ships an official, extensively documented CLI (@angular/cli). It covers workspace creation, generation via schematics, build, serve, test, e2e, lint, update, deploy, config, cache and terminal autocompletion, which gives scriptable command-line workflows an agent or AI-native user can drive. missing for 10: evidence of AI-specific CLI features (e.g. agent or AI-assistant integration in the CLI itself), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Install the Angular CLI globally: npm install -g @angular/cli
Generates and/or modifies files based on a schematic.
Compiles an Angular application or library into an output directory named dist/ at the given output path.
Set up Angular CLI autocompletion for your terminal.
